dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: #You seem to be in good shape, {NICKNAME}. Shall we begin the Shadow Realm combat simulation?

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Please be sure to make good use of cover and mechanisms. Identifying the most efficient approach to combat may prove beneficial for prolonged operations in the Shadow Realm...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Me? My name is Talalikhin Gogol. I serve as an ordinary clerk at the Adventurers' Guild headquarters...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: If you still remember the recent Adventurers' Guild Development Conference and Adventurers' Tournament... I had the honor of assisting with some of the arrangements during the event.

choices.text: An ordinary clerk... investigating the Shadow Realm?

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: It is only a personal interest of mine... together with a few rather unfortunate experiences. They have given me a somewhat deeper understanding of the Shadow Realm than the average person...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: I, too, wish to do what I can to help reduce the harm adventurers suffer because of it.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: According to the cases recorded by the Guild, the probability of surviving the Shadow Realm while retaining one's basic sanity is less than nine in ten thousand...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: However, that does not mean we should assume that falling into the Shadow Realm is certain death. It is always better to do all one can than to give up outright.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: If one can hone their firearm skills and use of fortifications to a truly masterful level, perhaps they may yet find a slim chance of survival.

choices.text: You think more like a soldier than a clerk.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Yes... Perhaps I was influenced by my uncle and his closest friends.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: When I was young, I could never quite hide my fascination with firearms. Uncle Gordienko's hunting rifle, in particular, was something I would study again and again.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Whenever Uncle Sidorenko, Nomokonov, and Vasily invited him to go hunting, my uncle would take me along.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: They taught me how to bring down the fiercest beasts from three hundred paces with a single shot, and how to conceal my tracks in the snow...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: After my fifth hunt, they even let me confront some monsters on my own, to test whether I had learned to turn distance into a means of protection.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Regrettably, my uncle and the three of them later went their separate ways, and saw less and less of one another...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: If even one of them had still been in Snezhnaya, Uncle Gordienko might never have let his guard down and been caught up in the Shadow Realm incident...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Ah... My apologies, I seem to have rambled a little. We should not lose ourselves in memories and what-ifs. Let us look ahead instead.

choices.text: So you were already an expert even as a child.
You put a lot of faith in weapons and tactics.
And an ordinary clerk came up with a simulation like this?
Has anyone else taken part in the simulation?

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Before the adventurer you just met, twelve others had attempted it. None of them performed as well as she did, however, and not one managed to complete the first simulation.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Her name is Lesnova. She is quite capable — she can complete A-rank commissions on her own with relative ease, and her progress has been remarkably swift...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: In terms of overall ability, I believe she is comparable to young Chichikova. That would put her at roughly one-tenth... perhaps even one-fifth of Mr. Alyosha's level. She has tremendous potential.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: I have benefited from his help indirectly. And, out of professional habit, I once made a rough assessment of his abilities based on scattered pieces of information. The conclusion was rather astonishing...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Of course, Mr. Alyosha does not know me. After all, he has helped quite a few people, directly or indirectly. I only hope that one day, I may have the chance to repay his kindness.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: As for the Guild, Lesnova's fiance, Radomir, has also returned to Snezhnograd, and she has been in exceptionally high spirits ever since.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: That said, Lesnova is not especially good at planning or managing her time. She often misses scheduled meeting points, and on quite a few occasions, her team has had to proceed shorthanded because of it...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: During the recent Adventurers' Tournament, Ms. Nadia and Rika both surpassed her with ease, leaving her with no chance of making the rankings.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: If she can improve that habit somewhat, I would like to recruit her, along with two other dependable comrades, to assist Lan...

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: She simply said, "Just warming up," and "No need to worry," then headed into the wilderness with her newly assembled firearm for what she called "combat camping."

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Perhaps, before taking that crucial next step, she wishes to acclimate to Snezhnaya as fully as she can.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: It is always best to be well prepared. If you are interested in how matters proceed from here, please await good news from us.

choices.text: Have you worked with Alyosha before?

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Understood. In that case, I will continue organizing the data.

dialogues.speaker: Lesnova
dialogues.text: Oh, did Talalikhin rope you into trying his simulation too? I saw the two of you talking for quite a while.

choices.text: That's right. Is there a problem?

response.speaker: Lesnova
response.text: I'm not very good at dealing with him, so... good luck.

response.speaker: Lesnova
response.text: Aside from this simulation, Talalikhin always makes whatever he has to take care of sound like no big deal... no matter how troublesome it really is.

response.speaker: Lesnova
response.text: But when he gives someone else a task — even something as simple as finding a lost cat — he'll remind them over and over to be careful, as if he's worried they'll miss a step and twist an ankle.

response.speaker: Lesnova
response.text: He always makes me feel like... maybe I'm not cut out to be an adventurer. Or to work as part of a team at all.

choices.text: I suppose so. Anyway, I should get going.

response.speaker: Lesnova
response.text: Well then, until we meet again.
